+"""Tests for clock implementations."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from slidewin.clock import ManualClock
+
+
+class ManualClockTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_cannot_advance_backwards(self):
+        clk = ManualClock(start=5)
+
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(
+            ValueError, "^cannot advance clock backwards$"
+        ):
+            clk.advance(-1)
+
+        self.assertEqual(clk.now(), 5.0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
